candidates.title: Board Game Sunday!
candidates.address: 13 S. San Antonio Road, Los Altos, CA 94022
candidates.audiences: Kids: Babies; Kids: Family Events; Kids: Grades 5-8; Kids: Grades K-8; Kids: Preschoolers; Older Adults; Teens
candidates.description:
Everyone is invited to play board games!

 Join us on the second Sunday of the month from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM.

 We have board games for all ages: adults, teens, and children.

 Come with friends & family!

 (The room closes at 3:30 PM, so come early enough to have time to finish your game.)

candidates.title: Happy Birds Presented by the Los Altos Library Commission
candidates.room:
Los Altos Community Center
Grand Oak Room
candidates.address: 13 S. San Antonio Road, Los Altos, CA 94022
candidates.audiences: Kids: Babies; Kids: Family Events; Kids: Grades 5-8; Kids: Grades K-8; Kids: Preschoolers; Kids: Toddlers
candidates.description:
NOTE: THIS EVENT WILL TAKE PLACE AT THE LOS ALTOS COMMUNITY CENTER GRAND OAK ROOM

 Join us for this special Happy Birds program presented by the Los Altos Library Commission.

 The Happy Birds Show includes over 25 amazing tricks performed by the show's famous talking and singing parrots! It is fast-paced and interactive fun for the whole family.

 Arrive at 10:30 to decorate a book bag or bucket hat. Happy Birds will begin at 11am.
